title: Project settings
summary: Per-project settings store: drag-lint settings list|get|set|unset over _D-RAG\drag-lint-project.json and a local overlay
intro: Read this when you want to see or change a per-project switch without hand-editing JSON: which lint config and profile a project uses, whether GetEnvironmentVariable counts as a taint source, and the existing project keys. drag-lint settings list shows every key with its value and where it comes from; set and unset write _D-RAG\drag-lint-project.json, or a per-machine .local.json overlay with --local.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint settings list|get|set|unset [<key> [<value>]] [--local] [--project <.dproj> | --db <db> | --in <file>] [--json|--format json]   (per-project settings in _D-RAG\drag-lint-project.json; --local = this machine only, _D-RAG\drag-lint-project.local.json; exit 0 done, 1 nothing to do, 2 refused)
help: drag-lint settings list|get|set|unset [<key> [<value>]] [--local] [--project <.dproj> | --db <db> | --in <file>] [--json|--format json]   (per-project settings in _D-RAG\drag-lint-project.json; --local = this machine only, _D-RAG\drag-lint-project.local.json; exit 0 done, 1 nothing to do, 2 refused)
